meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: Claude 会逐个完整阅读代码库中的每个源文件，包括所有文件；遇到大文件时使用分页工具分段读取。这样它能建立起对代码库整体结构的深入认知。
howto.when: 当你刚开始一个不熟悉的项目，或要求 Claude“学习代码库”、“阅读代码库”、“get up to speed”等时触发。

say.note: Claude 会开始完整读取所有源文件。

say.text: 请阅读整个代码库并理解它。
say.note: 它会逐文件通读，必要时分页。

say.text: 这个项目我不熟，帮我快速上手。
say.note: 对应“get up to speed”的触发。

howto.what_en: Claude will read every source file in the codebase in full, one by one, regardless of count. For large files, it pages through using offset/limit. This builds a deep understanding of the codebase.
howto.when_en: When you start working on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you ask to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

say_en.note: Claude will start reading all source files fully.

say_en.text: Please read the whole codebase and understand it.
say_en.note: It will go through each file, paging as needed.

say_en.text: I'm new to this project; help me get up to speed.
say_en.note: Equivalent to triggering "get up to speed".
